build.entry: Actual dashboard src/main.tsx; observer installed before mount
limitations: Isolated Vite configuration; this is not the deployable dashboard bundle.
Offline synthetic data and unavailable reader truth; no production or broker validation.
No hardware paint or competitor performance measurement.
Actual Scanner production fixture,200 historical synthetic bars; no real provider,broker,physical paint or competitor timing.
Desktop1440x1100,1x/4x CPU;20 measured toggles per condition plus4 retained warmups.
Completion is correct geometry/data on two frames; not guaranteed pixel presentation.
